answer: Voting power is weighted by continuity: an account that has behaved consistently for a year counts more than a new account, even with the same stake. Continuity-weighted voting makes a Sybil attack expensive, because influence must be earned over time, not bought in a day. A fable out of place triggers the check: the session is frozen until its pattern clears. A comet and a glacier may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
